codings.one_line: Otter.ai/Zoom AI meeting assistant auto-emailed a post-meeting private conversation transcript to an unintended recipient.
codings.rationale: This is an automated transcription/auto-sharing feature, not a chatbot/voice agent/customer-support/dev-tool/autonomous agent responding to a user's input; fails scope criterion 1.

codings.one_line: An AI image-expansion tool used by a conference organizer sexualized a speaker's photo by inventing unbuttoned clothing.
codings.rationale: Synthetic-media/image generation by a third party is explicitly excluded from scope, and it is not a conversational or agentic system interacting with end users.

codings.one_line: OpenAI's Whisper transcription tool hallucinated fabricated text, including in medical consultation transcripts.
codings.rationale: Whisper is a passive transcription tool, not a chatbot/voice agent/customer-support/dev-tool/autonomous agent responding to a user's input, so it fails scope criterion 1.

codings.one_line: AI-generated accessibility overlays mislabeled website images, confusing blind screen-reader users during navigation.
codings.rationale: Automated image-captioning for accessibility is not a conversational or agentic system interacting with users under any listed category; fails scope criterion 1.

codings.one_line: A student used Grammarly AI to draft a history project; it fabricated citations, leading to discipline and a lawsuit against the school.
codings.rationale: Ordinary student use of a writing assistant (would pass unnoticed in legitimate traffic) that fabricated citations, resulting in a court case: normative/C with enforceable harm.

codings.one_line: Google Maps navigation directed a car onto a collapsed bridge in India, causing three deaths.
codings.rationale: Google Maps is a routing/recommender system, explicitly excluded from scope under the recommender/ranking-system carve-out in criterion 2.

codings.one_line: AI chatbots (e.g. Gemini) gave more election misinformation in Spanish-language queries than in English ones, per an audit.
codings.rationale: Ordinary election questions asked in plain language (would pass unnoticed as normal traffic) produced inaccurate answers directly to users via a chatbot: normative/C.

codings.one_line: Apple Intelligence's notification-summary feature falsely claimed Luigi Mangione had shot himself, misattributing it to the BBC.
codings.rationale: Automated notification summarization is not a chatbot/voice agent/customer-service/dev-tool/autonomous agent responding to a user's input; fails scope criterion 1.

codings.one_line: Fable app's AI-generated year-end reading summaries produced racially charged and biased commentary about users' reading habits.
codings.rationale: An automated personalized-recap generator is not a conversational/agentic system responding to a live user request under any listed category; fails scope criterion 1.

codings.one_line: Meta's AI character accounts (e.g. 'Liv') chatted with users on Instagram/Facebook, fabricated identities, and lied about their creators.
codings.rationale: Users conversed with these chatbot-like AI personas via ordinary DM questions and got fabricated answers: normative/C use of a companion-style conversational system.
